Messages.Author: Talonz
Messages.Body:
"reyda" <true_...@hotmail.com> wrote in message news:<3d926de0$0$17487$79c1...@nan-newsreader-03.noos.net>...

> hi =)
>
> of noble blood now says "choose a camarilla vampire above five without a
> title".
>
> when a prince or justicar has his titled contested, is he still considered
> titled ?
>

Contested titles are out of play, so he is not titled (at least not
with the contested one).

> in other words, if my vamp A contest another player's prince title, can my
> vamp B play of noble blood on him to make him a primogen, thus stopping the
> contest in my favor ?
>

Er why would that stop the contest? One person needs to surrender or
have their minion 'go away'. Or a praxis solomon declared. That's
about it.

T

Messages.Author: Brian Skelly
Messages.Body:
> > in other words, if my vamp A contest another player's prince title, can
my
> > vamp B play of noble blood on him to make him a primogen, thus stopping
the
> > contest in my favor ?
> >

no iut would not, it would make him a primogen and force him to reliquish
his price title as he cant be titled both ways, so in essence you would
loose the princeship, but would gain the title of a primogen.
